mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and overall economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 2% over two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 2% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a low federal funds rate (below 2%) suggests accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a combination of rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over two months signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises & PAYEMS falls in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where both UNRATE increased and PAYEMS decreased over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a combination of increasing retail sales (RSAFS) and decreasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over three months signals improving consumer purchasing power, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases & CPIAUCSL decreases in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increased and CPIAUCSL decreased over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where a decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over two quarters signals a contraction in economic output, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during a recessionary regime.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 declined by more than 1% over two quarters during a recessionary regime.
